feedback: The measured Ubuntu recurrence result strengthens the separation of diagnostic trajectory/readout from proposal-only stopping/routing policy. Preserve receiver-use/outcome/reentry causality and do not let recurrence policy rewrite the diagnostic evidence. Database Pulse may include GWT competition/selection but a Pulse is not equivalent to GWT ignition, recurrence, or model inference. Add zero-model Pulse and fixed/event-driven baselines to causal comparisons.
counterhypotheses: Fixed/event-driven control may match or beat adaptive recurrence on real episodes after route cost and controller overhead.
Pulse-level state change may be useful without GWT ignition on some episodes.
